esqlQuery.esql: FROM metrics-azure.billing-* | WHERE azure.billing.actual_cost IS NOT NULL | WHERE azure.billing.usage_date >= DATE_TRUNC(1 month, NOW()) | STATS mtd_actual = SUM(azure.billing.actual_cost) BY azure.subscription_id | EVAL monthly_budget = 50000.0, month_elapsed_pct = TO_DOUBLE(DATE_EXTRACT("DAY_OF_MONTH", NOW())) / 30.0 * 100, budget_used_pct = mtd_actual / monthly_budget * 100 | WHERE budget_used_pct > month_elapsed_pct * 1.25 | SORT budget_used_pct DESC
